subject: brazil nuts
title: What If You Ate a Handful of Brazil Nuts Every Day?

scenes.text: What if you ate a handful of Brazil nuts every day? Your hair would notice first.
One Brazil nut holds 68 to 91 micrograms of selenium. You need about 55 a day.
So one nut covers your whole day. A handful of six can pass the safe limit of 400.
Keep that up, and your breath starts to smell like garlic, with a metal taste in your mouth.
Then your nails turn brittle and your hair starts falling out.
Selenium is a nutrient you need. Too much of it comes in a nut you'd call a health food.

description:
What if you ate a handful of Brazil nuts every day? Each nut contains 68 to 91 micrograms of selenium, while adults need about 55 and the upper limit is 400.
Regularly taking in too much can cause garlic breath, a metallic taste, brittle nails and hair loss.
